reports.title: morph-l2/go-ethereum Blockchain Security Audit Report
reports.description: SlowMist audit (March 4 to 31, 2024) of Morph's go-ethereum fork on the eip4844 branch (commits 523eaf60 to c7c40645), covering the L2 consensus engine, rawdb accessors, L1 message and batch types, the catalyst L2 engine API, clients and the miner. The entire scope is offchain execution-client software, with no onchain contracts or circuits reviewed.

reports.title: morph-l2/tendermint Blockchain Security Audit Report
reports.description: SlowMist audit (March 4 to 31, 2024) of Morph's tendermint fork on the layer2 branch (commits f7cf181d to a0e8684b), covering consensus, block sync, BLS signatures, configuration and the l2node interface. The entire scope is offchain consensus/sequencer node software.

reports.title: Morphl2 LRTDepositV1 Smart Contract Security Audit Report
reports.description: SlowMist audit (June 24 to 26, 2024) of the LRTDepositV1.sol pre-deposit contract (ETH, LST and ERC20 deposits with cross-chain forwarding) at commits e2e2651c to 2d190933, which was not deployed at the time of the report. The only scoped repository, morph-l2/LRT-Deposit, is not publicly accessible, and the contract is a deposit campaign contract rather than part of the rollup system.

reports.title: Morph L2 Security Assessment (Comprehensive Report with Fix Review)
reports.description: Fifteen engineer-week Trail of Bits review (April 29 to June 28, 2024) of the Morph L2 stack: the L1/L2 contracts (staking, Rollup, messengers, message queue, withdrawal tree, governance) and L2 node in morph-l2/morph at 1f623e0e, the tx-submitter at 34a89218, and Morph's go-ethereum (03fd4c3e) and tendermint (8ff3c98b) forks. A fix review (July 1 to 5, 2024) verified the fix pull requests, with TOB-MORPH-8 and TOB-MORPH-12 left unresolved.

versions.coverage: Contracts part of the morph repository target at the audit commit: review focused on the L1/L2 staking system, Rollup, the cross-domain messengers, message queue, withdrawal tree and L2 governance; the RLP encoding of L1 messages and the low-level batch commitment assembly were deprioritized. High TOB-MORPH-1 (L2/staking/L2Staking.sol) and TOB-MORPH-7 (L1/rollup/Rollup.sol) are located here.
Reviewed as part of the message queue; the RLP encoding of L1 messages used for the transaction hash was explicitly deprioritized (coverage limitation).

Rollup batch commit, challenge, pause and finalization logic reviewed; the low-level calldata-to-memory assembly of batch commitments was deprioritized. High TOB-MORPH-7 and Informational TOB-MORPH-8 target this file.
Reviewed as part of the staking system; Informational TOB-MORPH-5 (stale data not pruned) partly targets this file.
Reviewed as part of the staking reward distribution; Low TOB-MORPH-4 and TOB-MORPH-10 and Informational TOB-MORPH-5 target this file.
L2 governance proposal and voting logic reviewed; Medium TOB-MORPH-6 targets this file.
L2 staking, delegation and sequencer-set maintenance reviewed; High TOB-MORPH-1 and Informational TOB-MORPH-2 target this file.
Informational TOB-MORPH-9 (missing access control on withdraw) targets this file.
Token minting logic reviewed; Informational TOB-MORPH-3 targets this file.
L2 node part of the morph repository target: L1 syncer, executor and batch cache, block derivation from blob data and block proposal/validation/commitment flows reviewed; no findings.
PR #282 head: fix of High TOB-MORPH-1 (undelegation state manipulation) verified as resolved; only the fix was reviewed. File path renamed from L2/staking/L2Staking.sol.
PR #275 head (includes the merged PR #282): fix of Informational TOB-MORPH-2 (staker removal and sequencer set update) verified as resolved.
PR #277 head: minting and claim changes for TOB-MORPH-3 and TOB-MORPH-10 verified as resolved.
PR #308 head: fix of Informational TOB-MORPH-5 (stale delegator data not migrated) verified as resolved. File path renamed from L2/staking/Distribute.sol.
PR #281 head: fix of Low TOB-MORPH-4 (reward claims reverting) verified as resolved.
PR #277 head: fix of Low TOB-MORPH-10 (commission claim end epoch) and TOB-MORPH-3 verified as resolved.
PR #277 head: fix of Informational TOB-MORPH-3 (minting in the current epoch) verified as resolved. File path renamed from L2/system/MorphToken.sol.
PR #308 head: pruning of the stakers structure on slashing and withdrawal (TOB-MORPH-5) verified as resolved. File path renamed from L1/staking/L1Staking.sol.
PR #304 head: fix of Medium TOB-MORPH-6 (only current sequencer votes counted) verified as resolved. File path renamed from L2/staking/Gov.sol.

PR #301 head: the team's own fix for challenge resolution in batch reverting, noted in the fix review of TOB-MORPH-8 (which remains unresolved by design). This branch does not contain the PR #300 fix, so High TOB-MORPH-7 is still open. File path renamed from L1/rollup/Rollup.sol.
PR #300 head: fix of High TOB-MORPH-7 (challenges possible after unpausing) verified as resolved; Informational TOB-MORPH-8 unresolved.
PR #303 head: fix of Informational TOB-MORPH-9 (owner-only withdraw) verified as resolved. File path renamed from L2/system/L2TxFeeVault.sol.
Transaction submitter target (listed separately at this commit): selection of the sequencer responsible for batch submission and well-formedness of L1 transactions reviewed; no findings.

Target of High TOB-MORPH-11 (failed L2 transactions added to the skipped L1 transaction list). The go-ethereum target was reviewed only for Morph's changes (block creation, block validation, blockchain and consensus engine); the circuit capacity checker implementation was out of scope.
go-ethereum PR #99 head: fix of High TOB-MORPH-11 verified as resolved; the block production logic formerly in miner/worker.go now lives in this file.

It reported 2 High and 11 Medium issues, all fixed or acknowledged.

reports.title: Eip-7702 implement of morph-l2 Blockchain Security Audit Report
reports.description: SlowMist audit (October 10 to 16, 2025), commissioned by the Bitget Wallet team, of the EIP-7702 implementation in morph-l2/go-ethereum pull request #196 (state, transaction pool, transaction types and state transition). The entire scope is offchain execution-client software.

reports.title: Report for Morph Emerald upgrade
reports.description: BlockSec audit of the Morph Emerald upgrade, which adds AltFeeTx transactions for paying gas in registered ERC-20 tokens through the new L2TokenRegistry contract in morph-l2/morph and the matching transaction, fee, txpool, RPC and new precompile/opcode changes in morph-l2/go-ethereum. Only the changes from baseline Version 0 to Version 1 were in scope, with fixes verified at Version 2 (morph e64256ee, go-ethereum 64e9dcd0).

reports.title: Report for Morph Reth
reports.description: BlockSec audit of morph-reth, Morph's Rust execution client built on Reth and Revm, limited to ten files in the revm, primitives, txpool, rpc and engine-api crates (MorphTx handling, ERC20 token fee payment, pool validation and Engine API block assembly) at versions ac2e0351 and f60c2b2b. The entire scope is offchain execution-client software.
